name: Xingqiu
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Emblem of Severed Fate first (KQM: by far best in slot), an ER or ATK% Sands, a Hydro DMG Goblet, a CRIT Circlet and Burst first. KQM adds 4pc Marechaussee Hunter for when he is on-field. Weapons differ in the lead: Game8's best is Sacrificial Sword, KQM lists Primordial Jade Cutter first with Sacrificial Sword among the ER options; both are kept. Talent order: KQM off-field Burst > Skill (on-field Skill = Burst > Normal), Game8 Burst > Skill > Normal. His damage is the Burst's Sword Rain (54.3% to 97.7%, elemental curve). Goals are Game8's: ATK 1,800 or more, ER 180 or more, CR 60-70, CD 120-150 (upper ends used). KQM's ER depends on the weapon (Sacrificial Sword R3+ 150-180 before C6, Favonius Sword 190-220, other weapons 220-260), so 180 suits the Sacrificial build Game8 recommends. Partners are inferred (Pyro for Vaporize, Electro for Electro-Charged, Cryo for Frozen); the sources give no team list.
